resources.string: Basilar membrane position from the apex (x)

Greenwood (1990): Characteristic frequency (Hz) = 165.4 × (10^(2.1 × x) − 0.88). The position x is a fraction of the basilar membrane length, from 0 at the apex (low frequencies) to 1 at the base (high frequencies).
Distance from the base: %1$s%% of the basilar membrane length.

This one-dimensional teaching model shows tuning in a normal human cochlea. Its values are not personal measurements. Cochlear hair cells respond to sound; vestibular hair cells sense head motion and orientation relative to gravity. The model does not predict audiograms or guide treatment.
